takes.situation: Zhou is wiping down the car and haggles over how long the wait lasts.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Mind the paint. I drive the Councillor home at the chime.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Your pay card's been stamped short, we hear. One small favour, then.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Last envelope with "a small favour" came up short. Say exactly what.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: When he's in, we want him at the service bay, not home.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Don't say who "we" is. I can't repeat what I never heard.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Sensible. Wait there with him till we've finished.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Not for this money. A couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Long enough for us to get him out of the back seat.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Don't show me that. Anyone watching out here, I'll send off.

learned: Zhou's paid: Vale's car waits briefly.

takes.situation: Zhou won't take the envelope until the job is said aloud, then reads it back.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Not on the Councillor's bonnet. Last envelope said "nothing much", and lied.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: You drive him on short wages. We can mend a lean month.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Mend it how? My trip sheet says home, at the chime.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Not tonight. Once he's in, you drive him to the service bay.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Sit how long? This buys a couple of minutes, then I drive.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: That'll do. We'll have him out of that back seat.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Not in front of me. Anyone watching out here, I'll send off.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: The envelope's yours. You haven't asked who we are.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Can't repeat what I don't know. Chime, service bay, couple of minutes.

learned: Zhou's paid: Vale's car waits briefly.

takes.situation: Zhou is already counting the money, so the Fixer holds the taken envelope over the terms.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Hold on, I'm counting. Wages come by tube, and they come short.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: It's all there, and it's yours. Now, the Councillor's drive home.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Vague money's cost me. I drive the Councillor home, so what changes?

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Not home. At the chime, you take him to the service bay.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: The east yard. And after that I don't want to see anything.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: You wait with him. We get him out of the back seat.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Don't say who. Then there's nothing to get out of me.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: It's in your pocket now. You wait till we've got him.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Couple of minutes, then I'm gone. Anyone watching here, I'll send off.

learned: Zhou's paid: Vale's car waits briefly.
